item.title: A New Beginning
item.description:
From time to time I get the inspiration to post things to a website, usually after enough time has passed that my original toolchain has bitrotted away. That time has come again!

In the last round of blogging enthusiasm I started using a static site generator, and now enough versions have come and gone that it seems less annoying to just start from scratch than figure out how to upgrade. Now to figure out all the new features Hugo supports and if I need a single one of them.
